with our findings, which revealed no statistically significant difference in lymph node detection between [11C]acetate PET/CT and [18F]FDG PET/CT. However, some lymph node lesions detected by [11C]acetate PET/CT were not detected by [18F]FDG PET/CT. Furthermore, as shown in Figure 4, [11C]acetate PET/CT revealed more lymph node lesions than [18F]FDG PET/CT. Therefore, [11C]acetate PET/CT may be equivalent or even superior to [18F]FDG PET/CT for detecting lymph node lesions in CAEBV. Further studies are warranted to confirm the potential superiority of [11C]acetate PET/CT over [18F]FDG PET/CT.
